notes: Scrapper Clans "Wheezer": a wobbling fan (off-centre, one blade bent) behind a bent guard bar, a rust-patched duct with a hazard-taped joint that drips and wheezes a puff on the loop, one grey and one rusty tank with a faded green O2 band, amber lamps. Damaged: a blade has snapped off and the fan staggers, the duct patch has popped a bolt and gushes, lamps flicker red, a spark at the tank valve. Disabled: the fan is stopped with a blade hanging, the duct has pulled apart, the rusty tank has burst a seam, lamps dead.
